dataset.name: Palbo-Bio metastatic breast-cancer cohort (GSE186901)
dataset.description: Prospective HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast-cancer cohort with baseline bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual progression-free survival during palbociclib plus endocrine therapy.
dataset.cohort_context: The Palbo-Bio study enrolled patients with recurrent or metastatic HR-positive/HER2-negative breast cancer treated with palbociclib plus endocrine therapy. GEO releases 90 baseline or progression whole-transcriptome profiles from 67 patients. TRACE Explorer retains the 64 source-designated baseline profiles and excludes every progression biopsy before endpoint and expression analysis.

metadata.source_program: Palbociclib Biomarker Translational Research Group prospective study NCT03401359
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Europe PMC
metadata.library_method: Whole-transcriptome sequencing of fresh or FFPE breast and metastatic tumor specimens; source-provided gene-level TPM is transformed to log2(TPM + 1) by TRACE Explorer.
metadata.endpoint_context: Progression-free survival during palbociclib plus an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant
metadata.endpoint_definition_note: The source supplement reports PFS in months and a progressive-disease event indicator for every patient. TRACE Explorer preserves those source-coded values and does not infer unreported event causes.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Only titles ending in _Baseline_WTS are eligible. This leaves 64 unique patients with baseline expression, exact PFS and event status; 26 progression profiles and seven clinically annotated patients without a public baseline WTS profile are not analyzed.
metadata.baseline_specimen_caveat: The source baseline category includes both newly collected biopsies and archival surgical specimens obtained before palbociclib. Expression therefore represents the study-defined pretreatment tumor, but the interval from specimen acquisition to therapy is heterogeneous.
metadata.raw_access_note: Raw WTS reads are controlled under EGA EGAS00001005736. The complete processed TPM matrix, deterministic sample identifiers and individual endpoint table used here are public.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The GEO matrix has an unlabeled leading row-index column. TRACE Explorer records this structural defect, reads gene_name from the second physical column, selects the 64 baseline columns and excludes all eight rows belonging to four case-insensitively duplicated symbols.
metadata.overlap_note: This Korean prospective treatment cohort is external to TCGA-BRCA and is not pooled with the SCAN-B, MDX-BRCA, NKI, CNP, POG570 or BRCA-KR cohorts.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms pinned public files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms and the article's CC BY 4.0 license remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: One source-designated baseline biopsy or archival tumor specimen per patient before palbociclib plus endocrine therapy

expression.label: GEO TPM normalized to log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All rows belonging to the four case-insensitively repeated source symbols are excluded rather than merged without a source-defined rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) to the public source TPM values after selecting baseline samples. Values support within-cohort analyses and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival during palbociclib plus endocrine therapy
endpoints.time_origin: Start of palbociclib plus endocrine therapy
